headlines.title: Exelon to Announce Third Quarter Results on October 30
headlines.summary: CHICAGO, October 05, 2026--Exelon will hold its third quarter 2026 earnings conference call at 9:00 a.m. CT / 10:00 a.m. ET on Friday, October 30, 2026. The conference call will be led by Exelon President and CEO, Calvin Butler, and Exelon Executive Vice President and CFO, Robert Kleczynski.

headlines.title: EXC vs. DUK: Which Utility Dividend Will Actually Survive the Next Rate Battle?
headlines.summary: Two utility giants, two very different dividend histories, and one rate environment that could break the wrong one. The gap between Exelon and Duke Energy runs deeper than yield, and retirement investors need to know exactly where the danger sits.

headlines.title: Exelon’s 4.07% Dividend Yield Depends on Regulator Approval and Rising Debt
headlines.summary: Exelon's dividend yield has climbed to its most attractive level in years, but a single regulatory decision this December could determine whether that income stream grows, stalls, or forces a flood of new stock onto the market.

headlines.title: Utility giant Exelon’s climate arm backs grid-planning firm Continuum
headlines.summary: “Technologies that help the utility be more efficient in terms of building infrastructure … is a space that we're looking at,” Exelon’s Climate Change Investment Initiative lead told ESG Dive.

headlines.title: Exelon (EXC), Why Is The Utility Getting Fresh Attention?
headlines.summary: Exelon (EXC) has drawn fresh attention after recent trading, with the share price closing at US$42.07. Investors now have a clearer snapshot of how this regulated utility group currently trades. Recent trading has been softer, with the share price return declining 1.34% over the last session and falling 8.42% over 90 days. Exelon’s 5 year total shareholder return of 43.13% reflects a steadier long run compounding story despite that weaker near term momentum.

description: Exelon Corporation, a utility services holding company, engages in the energy distribution and transmission businesses in the United States. The company is involved in the purchase and regulated retail sale of electricity and natural gas; transmission and distribution of electricity; and distribution of natural gas to retail customers. It serves residential, commercial, industrial, and public authorities and electric railroads customers. Exelon Corporation was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.
